job_description: Develop and maintain cloud-native microservices using Python, Docker, and REST APIs. Collaborate with security and QA teams to ensure scalable and reliable deployment pipelines.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of Smoke Testing?
options: A) To validate every edge case in detail
B) To verify that critical functionality is stable enough for deeper testing
C) To measure database performance under load
D) To replace User Acceptance Testing
questions.correct_answer: B) To verify that critical functionality is stable enough for deeper testing
questions.rubric: Smoke testing checks whether the build is stable enough for detailed testing.

questions.prompt: Which testing type is most focused on ensuring that recent code changes have not broken existing functionality?
questions.rubric: Regression testing confirms that existing features still work after changes.

questions.prompt: Which detail is most important when logging a defect in Jira?
options: A) Personal opinion about the developer
B) Reproducible steps, expected result, and actual result
C) Only a screenshot with no description
D) The production release date only
questions.correct_answer: B) Reproducible steps, expected result, and actual result
questions.rubric: Good defect reports make issues reproducible and clear for developers.

questions.prompt: When testing an API in Postman, which status code usually indicates a successful resource creation?
questions.rubric: HTTP 201 typically indicates successful creation of a resource.

questions.prompt: Why would a test analyst execute SQL queries during testing?
options: A) To redesign the database schema
B) To validate backend data and confirm application behavior
C) To deploy application code to production
D) To replace UI testing completely
questions.correct_answer: B) To validate backend data and confirm application behavior
questions.rubric: SQL queries help confirm whether the application stored or retrieved the right data.

questions.prompt: What is Selenium WebDriver primarily used for?
questions.rubric: Selenium WebDriver automates browser actions for UI testing.

questions.prompt: In Agile Scrum, when are testers ideally involved in a user story?
options: C) From requirement discussion through execution and review
D) Only after developers finish coding all modules
questions.correct_answer: C) From requirement discussion through execution and review
questions.rubric: Agile testing works best when QA is involved early and continuously.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of a Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM)?
options: B) To map requirements to test coverage and execution status
D) To estimate developer story points
questions.correct_answer: B) To map requirements to test coverage and execution status
questions.rubric: RTM ensures each requirement is covered by test cases and tracked through execution.

questions.prompt: Which test design technique is most useful when input values have valid and invalid ranges?
questions.rubric: Boundary Value Analysis focuses on edges where defects commonly appear.

questions.prompt: What best describes User Acceptance Testing (UAT)?
options: A) Testing done by developers only
B) Validation that the system meets business needs from an end-user perspective
D) Automated browser testing using Selenium
questions.correct_answer: B) Validation that the system meets business needs from an end-user perspective
questions.rubric: UAT focuses on whether the solution meets real business expectations and workflows.

questions.prompt: How would you design test cases for a login page that supports valid login, invalid login, locked users, and password reset?
questions.rubric: Look for positive and negative coverage, boundary cases, validation messages, lockout behavior, password reset path, and data/setup assumptions.
questions.sample_answer: Cover valid and invalid credentials, blank fields, lockout thresholds, password reset flow, and expected system messages with clear preconditions and data.

questions.prompt: What information should be included in a high-quality bug report for a developer?
questions.rubric: Expect title, environment, preconditions, steps to reproduce, expected result, actual result, severity or priority, attachments, and reproducibility details.
questions.sample_answer: A good bug report includes environment, preconditions, reproducible steps, expected vs actual result, severity, evidence, and any relevant logs or data.

questions.prompt: How would you validate an API-backed feature using both Postman and SQL?
questions.rubric: Look for request validation, response assertions, status codes, schema or field checks, database verification, and handling of negative cases.
questions.sample_answer: Use Postman to validate requests, responses, and status codes, then run SQL queries to confirm the backend data was created or updated correctly.

questions.prompt: A new release for an e-commerce web app is ready. It includes checkout changes, new discount logic, and an updated order history page. As the Software Test Analyst, explain how you would plan and execute testing before sign-off.
questions.rubric: Expect requirement analysis, test planning, risk-based prioritization, smoke/sanity coverage, functional and regression coverage, API/data validation, defect logging, stakeholder communication, and release recommendation.
questions.sample_answer: Review requirements and impacted modules, prepare risk-based test cases, run smoke and functional tests on checkout and discounts, validate APIs and database data, execute regression on related flows, log defects in Jira, retest fixes, and summarize release readiness.

answers.q1: A) To validate every edge case in detail
answers.q3: A) Personal opinion about the developer
answers.q5: A) To redesign the database schema
answers.q10: A) Testing done by developers only
